parameters.query:
-- Legt die Monatsrechnung an (oder liefert die bestehende) – in EINEM
-- Statement: Positionen ermitteln, Nummer ziehen, Snapshot speichern und die
-- Bestellungen markieren passiert ganz oder gar nicht.
-- Advisory-Lock: Laufen Schedule und manueller Webhook gleichzeitig, wartet
-- der zweite und sieht danach die bereits angelegte Rechnung.
DO $$ BEGIN PERFORM pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext('etsy_rc_invoices')); END $$;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT $1::date                              AS period,
         ($1::date + INTERVAL '1 month')::date AS period_end,
         $2::date                              AS start_date
),
existing AS (
  SELECT r.* FROM etsy_rc_invoices r JOIN params p ON r.period = p.period
),
-- Bestellungen mit mindestens einem digitalen Artikel, die noch auf keiner
-- Etsy-Rechnung stehen. Nachzügler aus Vormonaten (z.B. nach einem n8n-
-- Ausfall verspätet synchronisiert) landen so in der nächsten Rechnung,
-- aber nie Bestellungen vor start_date (bis dahin manuell abgerechnet).
candidates AS (
  SELECT o.order_id, o.order_date, o.subtotal, o.shipping_cost, o.total, o.items_json
  FROM orders o, params p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM existing)
    AND o.source = 'etsy'
    AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.etsy_rc_invoice_number IS NULL
    AND (o.order_date AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date >= p.start_date
    AND (o.order_date AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date <  p.period_end
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(o.items_json) i
                WHERE (i->>'is_digital')::boolean)
  FOR UPDATE OF o
),
lines AS (
  SELECT c.order_id,
         (c.order_date AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date AS sale_date,
         x.titles,
         -- Etsy-subtotal = Artikel nach Gutschein, OHNE VAT und Versand.
         -- Gemischte Bestellungen: nur der digitale Anteil, Gutschein anteilig.
         COALESCE(ROUND(x.digital_sum * COALESCE(c.subtotal, x.all_sum)
                        / NULLIF(x.all_sum, 0), 2), 0)        AS net,
         -- Von Etsy erhobene VAT/Steuer (nur zum Abgleich): Brutto − Waren − Versand
         GREATEST(COALESCE(c.total - COALESCE(c.subtotal, x.all_sum)
                           - COALESCE(c.shipping_cost, 0), 0), 0) AS marketplace_tax
  FROM candidates c
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT SUM((i->>'price')::numeric * (i->>'quantity')::numeric)
             FILTER (WHERE (i->>'is_digital')::boolean)            AS digital_sum,
           SUM((i->>'price')::numeric * (i->>'quantity')::numeric) AS all_sum,
           string_agg(CASE WHEN (i->>'quantity')::numeric > 1
                           THEN (i->>'quantity') || ' × ' ELSE '' END || (i->>'title'),
                      ', ')
             FILTER (WHERE (i->>'is_digital')::boolean)            AS titles
    FROM jsonb_array_elements(c.items_json) i
  ) x
),
summary AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)                          AS order_count,
         COALESCE(SUM(net), 0)             AS net_total,
         COALESCE(SUM(marketplace_tax), 0) AS tax_total,
         MIN(sale_date)                    AS first_sale,
         jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
           'order_id', order_id, 'date', sale_date, 'titles', titles,
           'net', net, 'marketplace_tax', marketplace_tax, 'gross', net + marketplace_tax)
           ORDER BY sale_date, order_id)   AS lines
  FROM lines
),
-- Gemeinsamer Nummernkreis mit den Kundenrechnungen (Workflow 04)
bumped AS (
  INSERT INTO invoice_counter (year, last_nr)
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::INTEGER, 1
  FROM summary WHERE order_count > 0
  ON CONFLICT (year) DO UPDATE SET last_nr = invoice_counter.last_nr + 1
  RETURNING year::TEXT || '-' || LPAD(last_nr::TEXT, 4, '0') AS invoice_number
),
created AS (
  INSERT INTO etsy_rc_invoices (
    period, invoice_number, invoice_date, service_from, service_to,
    order_count, net_total, gross_total, marketplace_tax, currency,
    lines_json, seller_json, recipient_json, payment_note, note)
  SELECT p.period, b.invoice_number, (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Berlin')::date,
         LEAST(p.period, s.first_sale), p.period_end - 1,
         s.order_count, s.net_total, s.net_total + s.tax_total, s.tax_total, 'EUR',
         s.lines, $3::jsonb, $4::jsonb, $5, $6
  FROM params p, summary s, bumped b
  RETURNING *
),
marked AS (
  UPDATE orders o SET etsy_rc_invoice_number = c.invoice_number
  FROM created c, lines l
  WHERE o.order_id = l.order_id
  RETURNING o.order_id
)
SELECT r.*, FALSE AS is_new,
       to_char(r.invoice_date, 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS invoice_date_de,
       to_char(r.service_from, 'DD.MM.YYYY') AS service_from_de,
       to_char(r.service_to,   'DD.MM.YYYY') AS service_to_de
FROM existing r
UNION ALL
SELECT r.*, TRUE,
       to_char(r.invoice_date, 'DD.MM.YYYY'),
       to_char(r.service_from, 'DD.MM.YYYY'),
       to_char(r.service_to,   'DD.MM.YYYY')
FROM created r;
